visual_action: The video opens with a medium shot of Mike Pence speaking at a debate, looking serious. It then cuts to a tight close-up on the top of his white hair, where a housefly is resting.

cast.name: Mike Pence
cast.evidence: Mike Pence is shown on screen at what appears to be a debate stage. The entire video is focused on him and a fly that lands on his head.

on_screen_text.text: “this debate can't get any worse for me”
it might seem crazy what I'm about to say...

spoken_summary: There is no dialogue. The only audio is a song with the lyrics, "it might seem crazy what I'm about to say..."
audio_music: An upbeat, funky pop song plays throughout the video. The lyrics heard align with the on-screen text in the second shot. The track sounds like 'Happy' by Pharrell Williams.
editing_pacing: The video consists of two static shots with a single cut between them.
cultural_references: The video is built around a widely-circulated moment from the 2020 US Vice Presidential debate where a fly landed and remained on Mike Pence's head for several minutes.
The music used is the popular song 'Happy' by Pharrell Williams.
central_claim: The video uses a memorable and embarrassing moment from a debate to mock Mike Pence.
intended_effect: To make the audience laugh at Mike Pence by reminding them of a viral, unflattering moment.
